title: How X reacted to Anthropic's S-1

events.label: Junk credit rating + call to delay
FT: Blackstone sees junk rating post-IPO

coverage: X counted about 13,800 non-repost posts matching Anthropic + IPO/S-1/prospectus between Oct 19 and Oct 26 alone. This dataset is a relevance-ranked sample (perhaps 5-10% of total volume), far more complete for posts with real engagement than for low-engagement ones.
caveats: Hand-scored posts were labeled by judgment; keyword-scored posts use simple word lists and lean toward neutral. Non-English keyword posts mostly fall into the timing topic.
Wire-style headline posts count as commentary.
Posts repeat leaked or reported figures that conflict (e.g., $42B vs $80.7B losses; $518B/$600B/$750B compute). Nothing was fact-checked.
Interaction counts are snapshots and grow over time; dates are UTC.
Reposts and off-topic posts were excluded.
last_update_note: merged 34 new raw file(s) (+earlier files re-merged): +420 new via keyword pipeline, counts refreshed for 287 tracked posts; 22 posts hand-scored

caveats: Replies come from X recent/full-archive search for each conversation, ranked by relevance. The API returned at most ~25 replies per post in one page, so the target cap of 50 was rarely reached; long threads are under-sampled and biased toward replies X ranks highly.
Only direct and nested replies in the conversation are included. Quote posts were not collected (time/rate limits), so quote-tweet dunks — often the harshest pushback — are missing.
Spam/promo, self-replies by the original author, link-only and emoji-only/very short replies were dropped by simple rules; some bots surely remain.

Reply sentiment, stance and topic are keyword-scored (not hand-read). Sarcasm, non-English replies and memes are often misread; stance leans on cue words ("exactly", "cope", "wrong", "?") and on sentiment sign vs. the original.
For neutral news posts, "agree" means positive/approving replies and "disagree" means negative/skeptical replies, since there is no opinion to agree with.
Engagement weight = 1 + likes + reposts + replies + quotes of each reply. Combined conversation sentiment weights the original by its own interactions + 1.
